description: Core Setup & Architecture: Modern web app initialized with TypeScript strict mode, vanilla CSS design tokens, Vitest unit testing, and Playwright verification script.
Accessory Database & Registry: Comprehensive master catalog of SkyBlock accessories with base rarities, Magical Power values, categories, sources, and upgrade family hierarchies.
NBT Decoder & Accessory Bag Parser: Robust parser decoding base64-gzipped NBT data into structured accessory items (ID, name, rarity, reforge, enrichment, lore).
Owned vs Missing Accessories Engine: Accurate comparison engine matching player inventory against master catalog, resolving upgrade tiers so higher tiers fulfill lower tiers.
Magical Power & Bag Statistics: Accurate computation of total Magical Power (MP), completion rate, rarity breakdown, and enrichment count.
Profile & Player Data Loader: Support for loading player data via username/UUID/Pixel ID with policy caching, pre-bundled realistic profiles (Endgame, Midgame, Earlygame), and raw Base64 NBT input.
Visual Design & Hero Header: Premium dark-mode Minecraft aesthetic with glassmorphism, dynamic glowing rarity badges, policy disclaimer banner, and interactive stats overview.
Accessory Grid & Multi-Filter System: High-performance interactive grid with status filtering (All, Owned, Missing, Upgradable), rarity filters, category tabs, and real-time search.

Accessory Card & Interactive Detail Modal: Minecraft-styled visual tooltips and detail modal showing rarity coloring, lore, stat bonuses, reforges, enrichments, and acquisition guides for missing items.

Smart MP Optimization & Upgrade Recommendations: Intelligent recommendation panel displaying the easiest and highest value missing accessories to upgrade for maximum MP gain, with live Bazaar craft cost and Auction pricing.
Audio Feedback & Responsive Design: Synthesized Web Audio API sound effects for inventory interactions (clicks, chimes, bag opens) and fully responsive layout across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
Policy Compliance & Code Quality Gates: Full CraftersMC policy compliance, zero ESLint/TypeScript warnings, 100% Vitest unit test pass for pure logic, and modular source files under 300 lines.
Upgradeable accessories in Missing tab with dual Missing & Upgradable tags: Display upgradable accessories in the Missing filter view with both Missing and Upgradable badges.
Minecraft Inventory Chest GUI: Authentic 9-column Minecraft double-chest accessory bag interface with beveled slots, hover description tooltips, and click modal inspection.

Accessory Hierarchy, Wiki Recipes, Thaumaturgy MP, Pig's Foot Icon, and Minecraft Inventory NBT Slot Order Layout: Corrected families (Fire Talisman standalone, Fire Extinguisher -> Fire Devourer, Frostclaw Relic -> Red Claw Artifact, standalone Reaper Orb), verified CraftersMC wiki crafting recipes, Special rarity 5 MP, Pig's Foot sprite loading, and Minecraft inventory bag slot order with bottom Missing/Upgradable card grid.

Comprehensive CraftersMC Wiki Recipe & Price Verification for all 44 PDF Accessories: Fully verified crafting recipes (Feather line, Golden Feather Boots, Bamboo line, Farming Talisman, Farmer Orb, Vaccine Talisman, Coins Talisman, Emerald Ring, Magnetic Talisman, Gravity Talisman, Piggy Bank, Personal Compactors 4000-7000, Personal Deletors 4000-7000, Candy Relic, Bat Person line, Intimidation line) and authentic market pricing (Bazaar ingredients, NPC costs, Auction BIN snapshots without outliers).

Single-profile Header & Auction Fallback Display: Retained solely 'Fresh Profile' and 'Lookup Player' in hero bar; updated Potato Talisman as a Shiny Pig event drop, and displayed 'No offers were made in auction house' when listing history is unavailable.

Coin NPC Accessories Auction Price Suppression: Omit auction prices, AH badges, and auction house market boxes for all accessories purchasable from NPCs with coins, displaying guaranteed NPC coin costs exclusively.

Accurate NPC Base Accessory Craft Valuation: Upgrade recipes inheriting from base NPC accessories (e.g. Zombie Ring inheriting Zombie Talisman) use the guaranteed 500-coin NPC vendor cost rather than inflated auction listing prices.
